name: web-sage-and-cream-venture-capital-site-with-line-sphere-and-dot-icons
title: Long venture-capital page in sage, cream and charcoal with contour sphere, dot-matrix icons and duotone team
whatItIs: A tall page with a sage duotone topographic hero and pill nav, a big statement heading, a charcoal 'Outsized Value' section with a wireframe contour sphere and serif stats, cream tiles with dot-matrix icons for focus areas, a logo grid with a sage highlight tile, a duotone team grid, a closing statement and a footer with a giant cropped wordmark.
whatItMeans: Sophisticated and calm; muted sage with contour art feels like serious capital.
techniques: Use contour-line art as hero graphics.

vocabulary.definition: A globe drawn with topographic lines.
An icon made of a dot grid.
